summary_short.zh: 本库提供了一系列TensorFlow Lite格式的预训练模型，专为移动端、嵌入式及边缘设备优化，实现低延迟、低功耗的本地推理。这些模型经过量化等轻量化技术处理，在保持较高准确率的同时大幅减少计算量和存储占用。开发者可直接下载使用，或参考其转换流程将自有TensorFlow模型转为TFLite格式，从而在手机、摄像头、IoT设备等资源受限环境中快速部署AI应用，如实时图像分类、目标检测和语音识别，同时避免云端传输，保障数据隐私。

summaries.en: This repository contains a collection of TensorFlow Lite models optimized for on-device inference. It enables efficient AI deployment on mobile, embedded, and edge devices with minimal latency and power consumption. The models are pre-converted from popular TensorFlow architectures using quantization and optimization techniques. Developers can directly download these ready-to-use models or use them as a reference to convert their own models, enabling real-world applications like image classification and object detection without cloud dependency.

summary_short.zh: OTel-LLM-E4B-IT是一个面向电信领域的微调语言模型，基于Gemma 4架构。不同于常见的轻量适配器方法，它采用全参数微调，在专业电信数据集OTel上深入训练，既保留了基础模型的通用能力，又嵌入了深厚的领域知识。技术上，该模型专为RAG（检索增强生成）设计，可无缝集成外部知识库，实现精准的上下文感知响应。典型应用包括电信技术支持、客户服务对话、网络故障排查等。开发者可直接部署为对话机器人，或将其作为RAG的基础模型，构建实时电信专家助手。

summaries.en: OTel-LLM-E4B-IT is a fine-tuned language model for the telecommunications domain, built on Gemma 4. Unlike lightweight adapters, it uses full-parameter fine-tuning on a specialized telecom dataset (OTel) to deeply embed domain knowledge while preserving general capabilities. It is designed for RAG integration, enabling accurate, context-aware responses for customer support, technical troubleshooting, and network operations. Developers can deploy it as a conversational agent or embed it into RAG pipelines for real-time telecom assistance.

summary_short.zh: Qwen3-30B-A3B 是一个混合专家（MoE）大语言模型，总参数量达300亿，但每次推理仅激活30亿参数，大幅降低计算成本。其核心技术是稀疏激活：模型将参数分散到多个专家模块中，由路由器根据输入动态选择部分专家参与计算。这种设计在保持高性能的同时，显著提升推理效率，非常适合资源受限的场景。你可以用它进行文本生成，也可以基于Transformers库进行微调，或部署到需要高效语言理解的应用中，如智能客服、内容生成等。

summaries.zh: Qwen3-30B-A3B 是一个混合专家（MoE）大语言模型，总参数量达300亿，但每次推理仅激活30亿参数，大幅降低计算成本。其核心技术是稀疏激活：模型将参数分散到多个专家模块中，由路由器根据输入动态选择部分专家参与计算。这种设计在保持高性能的同时，显著提升推理效率，非常适合资源受限的场景。你可以用它进行文本生成，也可以基于Transformers库进行微调，或部署到需要高效语言理解的应用中，如智能客服、内容生成等。
summaries.en: Qwen3-30B-A3B is a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model that delivers high performance while activating only 3B parameters per token, making inference efficient even on limited hardware. Its key innovation is sparse activation: the 30B total parameters are partitioned into experts, with a router selecting a subset per input. This reduces computation dramatically without sacrificing quality. You can use it for text generation, fine-tune it with tools like Hugging Face Transformers, or deploy it for resource-constrained applications requiring strong language understanding.

summary_short.zh: Snowflake Arctic Embed XS是一款极小的文本嵌入模型，专为资源受限环境设计，在保持高质量的同时实现快速推理。它通过蒸馏技术从更大的Arctic Embed模型学习，并支持ONNX和transformers.js，可直接在浏览器或边缘设备运行。技术亮点在于其小巧体积下仍能提供有竞争力的嵌入质量。实践上，你可通过sentence-transformers库轻松集成，用于语义搜索、聚类或分类任务；也可在网页应用中直接调用，实现实时文本相似度计算。尝试用它来为你的移动端应用或低延迟场景构建高效检索系统。

summaries.en: Snowflake Arctic Embed XS is a compact text embedding model that balances quality with speed, ideal for resource-constrained environments. It uses knowledge distillation from larger Arctic Embed models, and supports ONNX and transformers.js for deployment on edge devices or in browsers. Use it for semantic search, clustering, or classification via sentence-transformers, or integrate directly into web apps for real-time text similarity.
